name: Content Visibility
author: sitetrail

sections.description:
Content Visibility is a free WordPress plugin that helps website owners analyze and improve how their content may be understood by AI search engines, answer engines, and traditional crawlers.

The plugin is designed for website owners interested in AI Visibility, AI Search Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Large Language Model (LLM) content optimization.

Using local, read-only analysis, Content Visibility scans your WordPress website for content patterns that may influence how AI systems interpret your pages, identify knowledge gaps, understand products and services, and evaluate content quality.

The plugin helps you review your website for platforms and technologies including:

  • ChatGPT Search
  • OpenAI
  • Google AI Search
  • Google AI Overviews
  • Google Gemini
  • Microsoft Copilot
  • Perplexity AI
  • Anthropic Claude
  • Apple Intelligence
  • AI assistants
  • AI answer engines
  • Large Language Models (LLMs)

Content Visibility does not guarantee rankings, recommendations, citations, or inclusion in any AI search engine or AI assistant. Instead, it helps identify content improvements that may make your website easier for AI systems and visitors to understand.

Ideal for website owners interested in

  • AI Visibility
  • Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
  • Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
  • AI SEO
  • AI Search Optimization
  • ChatGPT Search optimization
  • Google AI visibility
  • Perplexity optimization
  • Claude optimization
  • Gemini optimization
  • Copilot optimization
  • LLM optimization
  • AI content auditing
  • Content clarity
  • Knowledge coverage
  • AI-readable websites

Key features

  • Full-site batched content visibility scans
  • Resume-safe scan progress for interrupted scans
  • Local content visibility scans — no data is sent to external services during analysis
  • Findings grouped by content, performance, and store signals
  • JSON and CSV report export
  • Optional OpenAI BYOK to generate an AI Improvement Plan from completed scan findings (deliberate admin click only)
  • AI-readable public files: /llms.txt and optional per-page Markdown summaries from published content
  • Configurable scan thresholds and post types
  • Optional, contextual Sitetrail tool recommendations inside the plugin admin only

100% free

  • No Pro version
  • No upgrade wall
  • No locked features
  • No tracking requirement
  • No remote calls unless you click an external link

More from Sitetrail

The plugin’s dashboard also includes the Sitetrail Visibility Toolkit with four optional companion products: Sitetrail NewsPass, AI Live Chat PRO, Sitetrail Turbo, and Woo Toolbox. These links appear only within the plugin’s own admin pages. They never appear on the WordPress Dashboard, as admin notices, or on the public-facing website. No tracking parameters are appended to any URL.

Does Content Visibility send my site to OpenAI?

No — not automatically. Local scans run entirely on your server. If you optionally add an OpenAI API key, the plugin can generate an AI Improvement Plan only after you deliberately click Generate AI Improvement Plan on the dashboard. That sends a compact summary of your latest scan findings, not your whole website. AI-readable summaries are generated locally from published content unless you optionally enable OpenAI enhancement in Settings and click Generate on the dashboard. No rankings, citations, traffic, recommendations, or AI inclusion are guaranteed.

What are AI-readable files?

Content Visibility can publish an /llms.txt discovery file and optional /content-visibility-ai/{post_id}.md summaries built from published public content only. These are concise machine-readable briefings — not full post dumps — and do not expose private, draft, password-protected, or unpublished content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the content-publicity folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Content Visibility from the admin menu.
  4. Click Run full-site scan to generate your first report.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin add links to my public website?

No. External Sitetrail links appear only inside the plugin’s own admin pages and plugin row meta.

Does the plugin phone home?

No. Scanning and recommendation copy are handled locally. No network requests are made to Sitetrail unless you click a link.

Is Content Visibility free?

Yes. All core functionality is free with no upgrade wall.

Does the scan modify my content?

No. Scans are read-only.

Can I export scan results?

Yes. After running a scan, use Export JSON or Export CSV on the dashboard.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Major release — complete rebuild focused on AI content visibility analysis.
  • Full-site batched scanner with resume, cancel, and large-site safety controls.
  • Dashboard with grouped findings, summary metrics, JSON/CSV export, and persistent admin status.
  • Optional OpenAI BYOK AI Improvement Plan generated from completed scan findings (deliberate admin click only).
  • AI-Readable Files with /llms.txt and optional per-page Markdown summaries from published content.
  • OpenAI connection test in settings (tests the key only; does not power the local scan).
  • Sitetrail Visibility Toolkit with four informational product cards.
  • New External AI Ranking Factors education section with privacy-friendly video embed.
  • Local read-only scans — no site data sent to external services during analysis.
